# The Peacemaker

> Counter-service breakfast and lunch spot on Main Street in Brewster, Massachusetts (Cape Cod). Breakfast sandwiches, submarine sandwiches, salads, wraps, quesadillas, coffee, and pastries baked in-house. Open daily 7:00am-2:00pm: breakfast 7:00am-12:00pm, lunch 12:00pm-2:00pm.

The Peacemaker is a small, order-at-the-counter restaurant, not a chain. Sandwiches are named after well-known peacemakers and political figures (Mahatma, Dalai Lama, John Lennon, and others) as a running theme, not a factual claim about those people.

## Key facts

- Address: 2149 Main St, Brewster, MA 02631, USA
- Phone: +1-774-323-0529
- Hours: Daily, 7:00am-2:00pm (breakfast 7:00am-12:00pm, lunch 12:00pm-2:00pm)
- Price range: $ (budget-friendly)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/peacemakerbrewster/
- Amenities: outdoor seating, takeout, dine-in, free parking, wheelchair accessible, dogs welcome outside, card and contactless payment
